content: Today was a great day. I started off with a refreshing hike at Eno River State Park, which always puts me in a good mood. It was nice to get some fresh air and exercise before heading back to campus for practice. After a long day of classes and basketball, I ended the night by playing video games at my apartment, which helped me destress and unwind. Overall, I feel accomplished and ready to tackle whatever comes my way tomorrow. Time to get some rest and recharge for the week ahead.
